reason: I pay SAR 1,300 to 2,100 for film on a car I care about, and I have never heard of these partners. I would not hand over that money to an installer I cannot check, even if the price is fair, and I do not see any real reviews yet.
objection: I do not know these partners and cannot see real reviews yet. Anyone can get an ID and a commercial registration checked. I want to see the work on cars like mine and talk to someone who had it done.
would_change_my_mind: A few verified reviews with photos of finished work on M-series or similar cars from people in Riyadh, plus a partner I can call or visit before I pay.
